facts.fact: The report says Kenya's existing cybersecurity framework rests on the National Computer and Cybercrimes Coordination Committee under the Computer Misuse and Cybercrimes Act, to which the new National Cybersecurity Agency (Legal Notice 89 of 2026) adds capacity; published 2026-09-11, no other date given.
